welcome.title: Welcome to Maki Story
welcome.text: Bedtime stories, told with the voices of the people you love.

voices.title: Everyone lends a voice
voices.text: Mum, Grandpa, Grandma… each one records a character, even from far away.

listen.title: The child listens and keeps
listen.text: They turn the pages, find their favourite voices and keep their memories in their chest.
